summary: Iteration 7 — Stock Out (Issue Notes + Picking Notes) full-stack verification. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_issue_picking_notes.py covering issue-note creation/validation, prepare endpoint with pending_qty/already_picked_qty/available_qty, cumulative qty across PNs, per-location over-stock blocking, edit/delete blocked (409) when ANY PN exists, PUT cumulative excluding self via exclude_pn_id, /record creates OUT transactions and flips PN→RECORDED only (IN status pre-determined), RECORDED PN cannot be deleted, ?not_status=FULLY_PICKED filter. Frontend: /stock-out renders 2 tabs (Issue Note + Picking Note); IN/26-27/001 row shows status 'Fully Picked' with edit/delete buttons disabled; PN/26-27/001 row shows 'Recorded' status with Record button greyed to 'Recorded' (disabled) plus edit/delete disabled; PN dropdown excludes FULLY_PICKED IN; create-IN form has all expected testids (in-no-input, in-date-input, in-issued-to-input, in-add-row-count/-button, in-part-no-{idx}); creating fresh IN/26-27/003 (qty=3) and selecting it via UI loads items via /prepare; pending hint 'Pending 3 of 3' renders correctly; AVAILABLE LOCATIONS chips render with available_qty 'ML1/R10/— (7)' and 'ML1/R3/3 (23)' confirming smoke-check (R3/3 reduced 28→23 after the 5-unit pick); +Split duplicates row (qty=0 default), pending hint shows on both rows; over-allocation client-side check fires red border + 'Over 10/3' indicator + 'Avail 7 at loc' on BOTH split rows. 0 console errors / 0 page errors throughout. Test data cleaned up via DELETE.

critical_code_review_comments: _validate_picking_constraints correctly enforces BOTH cumulative cap (DRAFT+RECORDED counted) AND per-location availability (only DRAFT pending picks reserved) — matches spec exactly.
_recompute_in_status idempotent and reverts FULLY_PICKED→PARTIAL/PENDING on PN delete or qty reduction; picked_at unset when not fully picked. Good.
/record does NOT touch IN status (mirrors racking-note spec); IN status determined at PN save-time via cumulative qty.
Prepare endpoint correctly uses _pick_aggregate_other_by_loc (DRAFT-only) so RECORDED picks don't double-deduct location reservation (real balance already reflects them).
Final availability re-check inside /record uses real transaction balance (not DRAFT-aware) — correct safeguard if stock changed between save and record.
Frontend client-side over-alloc indicator groups by (part_no, make) across all rows including split rows — verified red border + 'Over X/Y' shows on both.
Minor UX: when a row has both missing-location AND over-alloc, save handler shows location-missing toast first (same as racking flow). Not blocking but could combine messages.

Issue Note model issued_to is free-text; spec describes 'the user who must create the picking note' but it's stored as plain string with no FK to users — acceptable for v1, future may want a dropdown to select an existing user.
